name: 催化评价折线+标记图 (Catalytic Evaluation Line-Marker)
when: Multiple catalysts, GHSV conditions, or poison/comparison runs evaluated across a discrete temperature/time grid (NOx conversion, N2 selectivity, N2O/NO2 byproduct concentration).

required_slots.x: Discrete independent variable column (e.g. Temperature in °C, 150-550 °C).
required_slots.series: 1..N numeric y-columns representing sample or condition curves (e.g. Catalyst-A, Catalyst-B, Catalyst-C, or GHSV 50k/100k/200k).

optional_slots.panels: Multi-sheet Excel or multi-file mapping for 1x2 (FigS2-S4) or 2x2 (Fig1, FigS1) grids.
optional_slots.note: Fixed condition text aligned below legend (e.g. GHSV = 50,000 h^-1 or Catalyst-B).
optional_slots.sd_columns: Optional replicate standard deviation columns; retained in provenance/QA only unless reference explicitly draws error bars.

data_contract.y_meaning: Conversion/Selectivity (%) in [0, 100] or byproduct concentration (ppm) in [0, 50].
constraints: Excel exports from Origin often have 3 header rows: row 0 = quantity, row 1 = unit (may contain Origin escapes like \f:Times New Roman), row 2 = sample name (e.g. Cu\-(1.26)-MAZ). Strip/parse cleanly.
Do NOT draw error bars unless present in original reference.
Do NOT silently alter source table values when source-vs-figure discrepancy exists (e.g. Fig1A Catalyst-A at 200/250 °C: plot source table values and log discrepancy in provenance).

notes: Fig1 & FigS1 are 2x2 (~7.09 x 6.0 in); FigS2, FigS3, FigS4 are 1x2 (~7.09 x 3.08 in).
FigS1 MUST lock y-axis to [0, 50] ppm across all 4 panels (N2O and NO2) so visual magnitude is directly comparable.
Use solid filled markers matching line color (mfc=color, mec=color).
Render chemical subscripts in bold upright/mathtext without italicizing numbers (e.g. Catalyst-A, NO$_x$, N$_2$, 50,000 h$^{-1}$).
